from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDetail(BaseModel):
    """A single extracted document with its title and cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., 二审行政判决书)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates extracted information from processed documents."""
    cases: list[CaseDetail]
